faqs.q: How much does Kipu EMR cost?
faqs.a: Kipu EMR pricing ranges from $600-10,000+/month based on facility size (bed count), not per-provider. Small facilities (10-30 beds) typically pay $600-2,000/mo. Mid-size facilities (30-75 beds) pay $2,000-5,000/mo. Large multi-site organizations pay $5,000-10,000+/mo for the full enterprise suite including CRM and analytics.

faqs.q: Is Kipu good for addiction treatment centers?
faqs.a: Yes, Kipu is the market leader for addiction treatment EMR. It's specifically designed for residential and outpatient SUD facilities with features like census management, utilization review, drug testing integration, alumni tracking, and addiction-specific clinical templates. Customers report 40% average census growth and 99% clean claims rate.

Yes, Kipu EMR is HITRUST certified, making it one of the few behavioral health EHRs with this enterprise-level security certification. This is important for facilities contracting with large payers or health systems that require HITRUST compliance.

faqs.q: What are alternatives to Kipu EMR?
faqs.a: For addiction treatment: Sunwave Health, Lightning Step, or Alleva EMR (all similar price ranges). For general behavioral health without addiction focus: Valant ($100-300/mo) or Netsmart myEvolv (enterprise). For small outpatient practices: SimplePractice ($59/mo) or TherapyNotes ($49/mo).

faqs.q: Does Kipu integrate with CRM for admissions?
faqs.a: Yes, Kipu offers integrated CRM (KipuCRM) for lead management, admissions tracking, and marketing attribution. This is a key differentiator for treatment centers focused on census growth. The CRM integrates directly with the EMR for seamless patient onboarding.
